authored_suite.root_dispatch_after_exact_harness_v2_pub: gh workflow run verify.yml --repo JasonPeng2019/proj-meridian --ref harness-v2 -f task=modules
authored_suite.scope: Synthetic PNG/typed inventories and existing scripted Python subprocess peer. Crop isolation; verbatim/null scan readings; supported template inventories; numeric/units/proofs/options; source changes/overlays; exact candidate/original image handoff; correction/reverification; persistent disagreement; explicit missing Opus; actual scripted execution failure/next-launch retry; blind guesses/missing or wrong image bytes; cross-field verdict rejection.
authored_suite.why: User requires all test execution remotely on Actions.

frozen_interfaces: Uses accepted M08 JobDefinition/EvidenceInput/EvidenceBundle, definition.request and with_field_validation, and current A02 typed contracts unchanged. No runner/config/package/contract edits.

public_api.VisionJob: Frozen pair: definition: JobDefinition, request: PrepJobRequest. Register definition under definition.job and call the accepted Runner with request.
public_api.build_scan_job: (drawing: DrawingEvidence, *, image_root: Path, crop_dir: Path, job_id: str | None = None) -> VisionJob
public_api.build_template_job: (drawing: DrawingEvidence, *, image_root: Path, feature_slots: int = 12, job_id: str | None = None) -> VisionJob
public_api.scan_readings: (job, original_drawing, result) -> dict[str, DrawingField]; in-memory projection retaining exact text, original whole-field boxes and all rounds. Invokes validate_vision_result. Unresolved is null/unsure and creates no human review.
public_api.template_review_details: (job, result) -> dict[str, JSON]; in-memory optional Debug/Review details, each actual candidate/verdict/failure per round and explicit missing_opus_output. Invokes validate_vision_result; no queue, decision or publication.
public_api.validate_vision_result: (job: VisionJob, result: PrepProvenance) -> PrepProvenance; REQUIRED before A11 publishes/counts/consumes accepted fields. Revalidates original bytes, typed source identity, each round candidate and field-specific verified-verdict citations, without repairing candidates or rounds.

real_corpus.full_new_prep: SKIPPED; mandatory ROOT/A11 redo after integration. Prior outputs remain historical.

resource_and_scope: No live prep/CLI readers, subagents, builds, tests, PDF/CAD/browser work or shared generated outputs. No shared package/config/contracts/plan/USER_TODO/other module writes.
root_requested_deltas: A11: register returned definition/request pairs and call validate_vision_result before publishing or counting any accepted vision fields; quarantine domain-invalid raw results as unresolved diagnostics.
ROOT: publish exact scoped tip on harness-v2 and execute the focused or existing modules Actions entrypoint. Remote runtime acceptance is still pending.
A11: reserve the actual sequential child CLI slot and run the full fresh determine-then-verify corpus pipeline; do not copy historical blind-reader outputs.
scan_evidence: Only measured corner fields of degraded original DrawingEvidence are eligible; all eight fields per page, including title-p2 etc., remain separate stable names.
Attachments are exact whole-field PNG crops computed from the supplied source-point boxes and actual page geometry; full scan pages are not attached.
Canonical typed inventory binds original PDF/page hashes, page geometry, source boxes, pixel bounds, crop keys and whole-field references. Each admissible scan ID owns only its original crop.
Original pages and crop bytes are rechecked; content-addressed output paths stay inside the assigned worktree development/testing split.
Known requires a sure nonblank/nonplaceholder string and exactly the field own ID; text is never trimmed, corrected, translated or repaired. Unknown remains null/unsure.
scope: Implementation and static inspection complete; remote scripted checks SKIPPED, not a runtime or real-prep acceptance claim.
static_evidence: testing/reports/b02/A09-vision/static.json; AST only, no product imports or local test execution.

template_evidence.derivations: Bounded AST arithmetic interpreter, never eval. References n0/n1/... index the recorded inputs. Supports +,-,*,/,unary signs and constant 2. Pattern proofs require an original page pattern_fact; CAD-frame/circle constants 0/90/180/360 are restricted to positions/angle paths. Every input must be admissible and used; reject extra constants, calls, powers, nonfinite values, unsupported units, wrong outputs or unprinted counts.
template_evidence.downstream_publication: A11 owns saved FlatTemplate/scan outputs and must attach ValueEvidence from the ledger when materializing native geometry. Preserve partial unknown subfields, omit only actually verified absent feature slots, and retain full provenance for Review/Debug. No native template assets or engineering values were generated here.
template_evidence.field_inventory: Stable /template/outline, /thickness, /material, /weight-on-drawing, /feature-01 through /feature-12 (default, configurable 1..32), and /proofs. Feature slot count is a bound, never seeded geometry.
template_evidence.inputs: Exact original PNGs plus canonical compact sorted UTF-8 JSON of unmodified deterministic DrawingEvidence and a versioned admissibility/field inventory. Reject prior AI/human overlays.
template_evidence.numeric_checks: Check actual token spelling/value, positioned original word, sure confidence, drawing namespace, positive dimensions, schema/integer/boolean types and declared units. Exclude border/grid and corner/title-block numbers as geometry. Weight uses only its sure own corner number and grams; material is verbatim sure corner text; thread text must occur in original drawing words on the cited page.
template_evidence.options: Scalar options only; distinct own directly printed numeric IDs plus a locally detected explicit printed connector (or/eller/either/alternative/alt.) and group reference. Two dimensions, equal strings, two reader guesses or disagreement do not create options. Unsupported printed notation remains unresolved.
template_evidence.proofs: Known proofs.value={entries:[{field:<stable field name>,option:null|zero-based index,path:<JSON pointer>,evidence:<frozen ValueEvidence>}]}. Numeric values cite one actual admissible number ID or a recorded derivation. All used IDs must equal that candidate field supporting source_ids. No evidence wrappers alter semantic values.
template_evidence.semantic_values: Outline/feature values use bare semantic geometry compatible with template_candidate_value. Every scalar leaf has its own proof. Unknown subfields retain {state: unknown}; known {kind: absent} requires image-backed proof and explicit verification. Overflow remains unknown, never silently omitted.

verification_boundary.cache: Versioned domain policy, fixed inventory, stage-specific prompts, schema/contract, source and candidate binding go through M08. No historical blind-reader cache is read or copied.
verification_boundary.domain_final_check: M08 generic parsing validates job-wide reference ownership. validate_vision_result additionally requires every verified verdict to cite the exact supporting IDs of its own candidate field. A11 must call it before publication/counting. On EvidenceError, preserve raw runtime provenance for diagnostics and report domain-invalid/unresolved; do not publish raw generic accepted flags as verified or treat the error as an execution-failure fallback.
verification_boundary.ordered_rounds: Entirely delegated to the accepted shared runner: one Sol correction plus one Opus reverification only on explicit disagreement; preserve both rounds; persistent disagreement/unsure/invalid stays unresolved.
verification_boundary.prompts: Sol determines from original images; Opus verifies the exact supplied candidate with explicit per-field verdict/reason/evidence. Original geometry meaning, text, units, pattern counts and alternative association require actual Opus inspection. Alternatives remain feedback requiring Sol correction/reverification.
verification_boundary.unverified_exception: Only genuine Opus execution failure in the initial round, as classified by M08, permits valid source-backed Sol-only continuation. No new fallback logic. Projection uses ai_single_model and Review records missing Opus. Retry Opus next launch through the shared runner.
